system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Insight and Medicine, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Anatomy Lore, Herbalism Lore, Midwifery Lore.
system.description: You tended the sick and injured, learning to keep your hands steady when others were losing hope. Patients trusted you with their pain, and sometimes with things they had told no one else.
